source_context.finding: The narrative is an overview and expressly defers to remaining drawings/specifications on conflicts. Equipment ratings and redundancy statements here must be reconciled against actual schedules/controls, not used as overriding truth.

Air Operations has AHU-A1/A2, dedicated outdoor-air units, fan coils, chilled-water and hot-water plants. MTRACON and ATCT share a chilled-water plant with heat recovery and separate secondary distributions; critical-room redundancy is explicitly discussed.
ATCT includes DOAH-T1, fan coils, redundant cab AHU-T1A/B and stair pressurization SPF-T1. Final per-unit specifications, controls and quantities await the remaining source pages.
BACnet DDC is required with capability to tie into existing MCAS Cherry Point Utility Management System. Specific transports, controller topology and point allocations require the M700-series review.
